The HWPX inventory report generation succeeded by correctly parsing the XML-based document structure and passing all automated validation checks.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without errors. Success relied on accurately navigating the HWPX ZIP-compressed XML schema, though future iterations should verify handling of malformed XML or missing namespaces. The final output was validated by the judge with a reward of 0.74, confirming the generated report met the structural requirements.
